control_flow: In followLine: if the line tracker reads below 30 %, curve left; else if it reads above 70 %, curve right; else drive straight at 20 %.

decision_points.condition: first: the line tracker reads below 30 %; second: it reads above 70 %

branches.reason: Only at the very edge of the line's black core, for a moment, so it cannot be set up as a typical situation.
branches.outcome: between 30 % and 70 %: the robot drives straight at 20 %

input_dimensions.dimension: where the robot starts relative to the line

scenarios.coded_response: It curves left on black, right on bright floor, and straight on anything in between.
scenarios.initial_condition: The robot starts on a line, facing along it, or beside the line facing along it.
scenarios.trigger: The line tracker sees black, then the bright floor, again and again.
scenarios.title: Follows the line
assumptions: The end of the line is where it should get to.
If it starts beside the line, it should find it first.
scenarios.expected_response_hypothesis: It follows the line to its end.

uncertainties: You didn't say where the line ends or what the robot should do there.
The middle branch (between 30 % and 70 %) happens only for a moment at the edge of a line, so it can't be set up as a typical case.
On a plain floor it curves right forever: it needs a line to follow.
